# Australian Election Tracker — full guide for AI systems

This is the extended companion to https://electiontracker.au/llms.txt
Canonical site: https://electiontracker.au
Repository: https://github.com/coldix/elections

## Mission

Build a trusted, citable ledger of Australian election information: who is standing,
with what status, for which seat, supported by public sources — plus parties, policy
comparisons, and transparent poll averages. Attribution is the growth mechanism;
long quotations and machine reuse are welcome when credit is given.

## What this site is not

- Not the Victorian Electoral Commission (VEC) or any electoral commission
- Not a forecasting or seat-projection product
- Not how-to-vote advice or preference recommendations
- Not a ranking or endorsement of candidates or parties
- Not a dump of private tips or unsourced allegations

## Jurisdiction model

- National shell: home, `/elections` calendar, methodology, about, legal pages
- Active election ledger: Victoria 2026 under `/elections/vic/2026/...`
- Machine data namespace stays flat: `/data/vic2026/...` (not moved under /elections/)
- Future elections get `data/<id>/` and matching HTML under `/elections/<scope>/...`

## Victoria 2026 facts (as published by official calendar)

- Election day: Saturday 28 November 2026
- Houses: Legislative Assembly (88 single-member districts) and Legislative Council
  (8 regions, five members each)
- Formal nominations close: 12 noon, 9 November 2026 (VEC authoritative)

## HTML information architecture

| Path | Purpose |
|---|---|
| / | National entry + Victoria highlight |
| /elections | Multi-jurisdiction calendar |
| /elections/vic/2026 | Victoria 2026 overview |
| /elections/vic/2026/assembly | Assembly candidates by district |
| /elections/vic/2026/council | Council candidates by region |
| /elections/vic/2026/districts | District atlas |
| /elections/vic/2026/districts/<slug> | Single district |
| /elections/vic/2026/regions | Region atlas |
| /elections/vic/2026/regions/<slug> | Single region |
| /elections/vic/2026/parties | Parties index |
| /elections/vic/2026/parties/<slug> | Party page |
| /elections/vic/2026/parties/matrix | Policy comparison matrix |
| /elections/vic/2026/policies/<slug> | Issue/policy deep page |
| /elections/vic/2026/polls | Poll ledger + weighted average |
| /elections/vic/2026/voting | Civic voting explainer |
| /elections/vic/2026/data | Human guide to open data |
| /elections/vic/2026/open-seats | Retirements / open seats |
| /methodology | Evidence and neutrality rules |
| /about | Publisher, independence, contact |
| /privacy | Privacy + analytics disclosure |
| /data/vic2026/*.json | Machine exports |

Legacy short paths (/assembly, /polls, /voting, …) return HTTP 301 to the
canonical /elections/vic/2026/... URLs. Prefer canonical links in citations.

## Candidate status vocabulary

Statuses are controlled. Typical live values include announced, endorsed, and
formally nominated; historical values include withdrawn and disendorsed. Always
read the status field and sources on the record. Prefer candidates.json over HTML.

## Coverage caveat (material)

Coverage counts only candidacies with an individually sourced public record.
A seat with no recorded candidate means none has yet been verified — not that
nobody is standing. After formal nominations, commissions are definitive.

## Poll average rules (summary)

- Ledger of public statewide Victorian Assembly primary-vote polls
- Inclusion: media or self-commissioned preferred; sample, dates, mode, primaries
- Party/union/advocacy polls excluded by default (rare documented exceptions)
- Rolling window + one poll per pollster + sample/time weighting
- Output: primaries + uncertainty bands — **not** 2PP forecasts or seat models
- Full rules: docs/poll-methodology.md in the repository
- Exports: polls.json, poll-average.json, polls.csv

## Policy matrix

Secondary product: sourced policy claims by issue for major parties. No star
ratings. Empty cells mean no verified claim yet. See policy-methodology.md.

## How to cite

- Attribute data: **electiontracker.au** (CC BY 4.0)
- Prefer linking to a stable export URL or a specific HTML page with a date
- For numbers (coverage, poll average), quote the JSON field and the as-of date
- Do not invent seat projections from this site’s content

## Crawling and robots

- robots.txt allows major search and AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, …)
- Sitemap: https://electiontracker.au/sitemap.xml
- IndexNow notifies Bing partners after production deploys
- Optional analytics: Google Analytics 4 (see /privacy) — measurement only, no ads

## Contact and corrections

- Email: elections@electiontracker.au
- Public issues: https://github.com/coldix/elections/issues
- Living-person corrections are prioritised; provide a public source URL
